items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: the one that you made with Ray Bryant and his brother Tommy Bryant and you, called Jo Jones Plus Two.

ctx.x: You must remember, I came through Canada and Ray Bryant was playing with Carmen McCrae. I said, "You're fired." So I formed a trio for one year. I had it for 11 1/2 months. I had Ray Bryant and his brother and I said, now this is it. Then after I did that, then I left and I went to San Juan to open up Ochos Puertos, Hinton: Ochos Puertos. Eight Doors. There was a laundry there. It was one block from the Governor's mansion in old San Juan. I was in Pepi Alegria and I had a partner that understood about musicians…

One of the finest records I think I've ever heard of a trio, and one of the best recorded drum albums I've ever heard in my life, is the one that you made with Ray Bryant and his brother Tommy Bryant and you, called Jo Jones Plus Two.
We didn't know what we was doing... so we just sat down and played naturally.
